title: Check preview worker health
responsibility: Authenticates private worker health probes, observes repeated server failures and reports whether project agents are active.

inputs.name: previewHealth.token
inputs.description: Per-worker probe secret shared only through the child environment and request header.

inputs.name: readPreviewHealth.url
inputs.description: Exact loopback address of the worker spawned by the supervisor.

inputs.name: readPreviewHealth.token
inputs.description: Probe secret for this worker generation.

outputs.name: closePreviewSessions
outputs.description: Cancels the current worker’s owned project requests before normal shutdown.

outputs.name: previewHealth
outputs.description: Vite middleware exposing authenticated health and counting server failures.

outputs.name: readPreviewHealth
outputs.description: Worker identity, recent error count and active-agent flag.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects a failed or unexpected health response; network errors and probe timeouts propagate to the supervisor.

dependencies.contract: Shared worker sessions expose busy and close through Symbol.for("harness.console.agents").
